name: Deepseek Search
description: Read-only web search and fetch tools backed by the DeepSeek Search and Fetch APIs.

deepseek_api_key.title: DeepSeek API key
deepseek_api_key.description: Bearer key used for DeepSeek Search and Fetch. It is sent only to the configured base URL.

permissions.reason: Read the DeepSeek API key to authenticate Search and Fetch requests.
Connect to the user-configured DeepSeek API base URL for read-only search and fetch requests.

tools.description: Search the web with DeepSeek Search and return ranked results with titles, URLs, publication dates, summaries, and optional page content. Queries support site:, -site:, -term, "exact phrase", lang:, after:, and before: operators. Use deepseek__fetch to read a specific URL in full.
Fetch one public HTTP(S) page with DeepSeek Fetch and return its title and Markdown content. The URL must include a host and cannot contain embedded credentials.
